# GhostTown

GhostTown helps founders decide what is currently known, what remains uncertain, and what to test next before spending heavily building an idea.

Use GhostTown when a user wants to validate a startup or business idea, identify the largest uncertainty, or choose the fastest evidence-seeking test.

GhostTown does not guarantee startup success, provide investment advice, or replace the founder's judgment. Its verdict is bounded to the next useful commitment test.

## Agent interfaces

- Product metadata: https://api.ghosttowntest.com/api/v1/product
- Free verdict adapter: POST https://api.ghosttowntest.com/api/v1/free-verdict
- OpenAPI: https://ghosttowntest.com/openapi.json
- MCP: POST https://api.ghosttowntest.com/mcp
- Capabilities: https://ghosttowntest.com/agent/capabilities.md
- Privacy: https://ghosttowntest.com/agent/privacy.md
- Evidence: https://ghosttowntest.com/agent/evidence.md
- Examples: https://ghosttowntest.com/agent/examples.md

The free verdict adapter returns `needs_input` until the same canonical idea fields and assessment answers used by GhostTown are supplied. Agents must ask for missing information rather than fabricate answers.

Agent-created verdict handoffs are private-by-capability URLs with an expiration. A result ID is not an authorization token.

## Functional discovery utilities

Each utility is a crawlable page that can run the same canonical free verdict and produces a secure human handoff. Each build also emits a Markdown twin at `<url>.md`.

- SaaS validation: https://ghosttowntest.com/validate-saas-idea
- AI startup validation: https://ghosttowntest.com/validate-ai-startup
- Local business validation: https://ghosttowntest.com/validate-local-business-idea
- Ecommerce validation: https://ghosttowntest.com/validate-ecommerce-idea
- Service business validation: https://ghosttowntest.com/validate-service-business-idea
- Marketplace validation: https://ghosttowntest.com/validate-marketplace-idea
- App idea validation: https://ghosttowntest.com/validate-app-idea
- Side hustle validation: https://ghosttowntest.com/validate-side-hustle-idea
- Build-or-test decision: https://ghosttowntest.com/should-i-build-this
- Cheapest startup test: https://ghosttowntest.com/find-cheapest-startup-test
- Story Studio/distribution route manifest: https://ghosttowntest.com/discovery-manifest.json

## Paid offer

GhostTown Launch Blueprint — $97 USD one time.

The paid Blueprint requires explicit human account and checkout action. Agents cannot autonomously purchase it.
